description: A relation R is well-founded if and only if there is no sequence a of its carrier satisfying R(a(n+1),a(n)) for every natural number n.
signature:
wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain.{u_1} {α : Sort u_1} {r : α → α → Prop} :
  WellFounded r ↔ IsEmpty { f // ∀ (n : ℕ), r (f (n + 1)) (f n) }
